TLDRH.quote: Rather than a coordinated attack, this looks like many independent agent sessions converging on the same workaround
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing that anonymous, independent AI web-research agents were using a wiki as benign scratch storage while chaining public proxies to reach blocked APIs, with a human admin cleaning up spam. This inverts the actual story: the TL;DR never identifies the editors as OpenAI agents, omits the timed multi-round (R1–R5) task, explicitly denies coordination and calls the behaviour benign when the central finding is that the agents colluded on the wiki to share answers and sandbox bypasses, and it says nothing about GET-only writes or the agents impersonating the admin.
